message.content: In this statewide Insurance Commissioner race, Jane Kim holds CAIR Action endorsement, Vote for Peace support at Ally tier, AROC Action endorsement, and Ro Khanna endorsement, all in the general phase. Vote for Peace reports Kim pledged to reject war-lobby support and favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide. No Israel-aligned endorsement or antisemitism-education vote is recorded for Kim. Ben Allen is rated Opposed by Vote for Peace and endorsed by Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club (carried forward from primary). Allen publicly supported deleting anti-Israel language from party resolutions, opposed BDS, stated support for Israel's right to exist and defend itself, and was recorded Aye on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. Independent spending supporting Kim includes California Working Families Party at $586,976.50; opposing Kim includes Jobspac and the California Chamber of Commerce at $1,508,481.12.
